# opnsense_radvd_entry (Resource)

IPv6 router advertisements (**Services ▸ Router Advertisements**), one entry per interface.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_radvd_entry" "lan" {
  interface = "lan"
  mode      = "assist"
  dnssl     = ["home.example"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `interface` (String) Interface to advertise on, e.g. `lan`.

### Optional

- `base_interface` (String) Interface whose IPv6 prefix is advertised, for tracked interfaces.
- `cur_hop_limit` (Number) Hop limit advertised to clients. Defaults to `64`.
- `default_lifetime` (Number) Router lifetime, in seconds. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `default_preference` (String) Default router preference. Defaults to `medium`.
- `deprecate_prefix` (String) DeprecatePrefix option: `on`, `off`, or empty for the default. Defaults to ``.
- `dns` (Boolean) Advertise DNS servers and search domains. Defaults to `true`.
- `dnssl` (Set of String) DNS search domains to advertise. Defaults to `[]`.
- `dnssl_lifetime` (Number) Lifetime of the advertised search domains, in seconds. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether router advertisements are sent on this interface. Defaults to `true`.
- `link_mtu` (Number) MTU to advertise. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `max_interval` (Number) Maximum interval between unsolicited advertisements, in seconds. Defaults to `600`.
- `min_interval` (Number) Minimum interval between unsolicited advertisements, in seconds. Defaults to `200`.
- `mode` (String) Advertisement mode: `router` (router only), `unmanaged` (SLAAC), `managed` (DHCPv6), `assist` (SLAAC and DHCPv6), `stateless` (SLAAC and stateless DHCPv6). Defaults to `stateless`.
- `nat64_prefix` (String) NAT64 prefix to advertise (PREF64).
- `preferred_lifetime` (Number) Preferred lifetime of the prefix, in seconds. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `rdnss` (Set of String) DNS servers to advertise. Empty advertises the firewall when `dns` is enabled. Defaults to `[]`.
- `rdnss_lifetime` (Number) Lifetime of the advertised DNS servers, in seconds. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `remove_adv_on_exit` (String) RemoveAdvOnExit option: `on`, `off`, or empty for the default. Defaults to ``.
- `remove_route` (String) RemoveRoute option: `on`, `off`, or empty for the default. Defaults to ``.
- `route_lifetime` (Number) Lifetime of the advertised routes, in seconds. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `routes` (Set of String) Additional routes to advertise, in CIDR notation. Defaults to `[]`.
- `source_address` (String) Source address of the advertisements.
- `valid_lifetime` (Number) Valid lifetime of the prefix, in seconds. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the router advertisement.

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import opnsense_radvd_entry using the `id`. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_radvd_entry.example
  id = "<opnsense-resource-id>"
}
```

Using `terraform import`, import opnsense_radvd_entry using the `id`. For example:

```console
% terraform import opnsense_radvd_entry.example <opnsense-resource-id>
```
